text:
linh: kicking off a controlled v2 rollout tonight. plan: shadow-forward 5% of production traffic to /api/v2 (mirror, not switch). change window 02:00-05:00 UTC. if green after 2h we ramp to 25% then evaluate full cutover.
jess: do we have enterprise tenants pinned to v1? need to avoid accidental drift.
linh: yes — enterprise accounts remain pinned to v1 by default. we'll respect the x-tenant-pin header and the admin pinlist.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy created by linh at 02:00 UTC
deploy-bot: run command: `./deploy --env=prod --mode=shadow --route=/api/v2 --mirror=0.05`
matt: quick compatibility question — streaming payload shape changed (newline framing). mobile SDKs might choke. have we gated streaming for shadow? or mirror only unary calls?
linh: mirror only non-streaming endpoints for this wave. streaming will be tested separately next week.
sara: telemetry looks ok from the canaries. 95th p99 latency delta +12ms, error rate +0.01% on mirrored traffic (noise).
ops-oncall: set alert playbook: if mirrored error_rate >= 0.3% for 10m OR p95 latency increase >= 80ms -> page SRE.
linh: rollback criteria agreed: if production errors increase by >=0.5% (rolling 5m) OR user-facing 5xx spike, we stop mirror and roll forward nothing. deploy-bot will auto-stop mirror if threshold hit.
jess: tagging release notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/v2-shadow-forward-2026-03-21 — add note about enterprise pinning and streaming caveat.
matt: can we add a temporary header gate for early adopters? like `x-api-version: beta-2` so clients can opt-in.
linh: yes adding header gate. ops: please add short-lived routing rule to prefer `x-api-version` when present.
ops-oncall: done. rule added to routing config `prefer_header_version` -> respects x-api-version for 6h.
deploy-bot: mirror started at 02:10 UTC, mirror rate=5%, route=/api/v2, mirror-id=mirror-4022
jess: test curl for opt-in:
```bash
curl -H "x-api-version: beta-2" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
linh: running smoke set: 200 quick requests via opt-in header across EU/US regions.
sara: smoke pass in eu-west, us-east. no client-visible regressions in sampled sessions.
matt: can we also pin a small tenant subset (staging customers) to v2 for deeper QA? I'd like to run the internal lint/ev tests.
linh: assigning two tenants to staging list now: tenant-42, tenant-128. they will be unpinned after 24h or on rollback.
deploy-bot: observability links: traces: https://observability.redwood.ai/trace/mirror-4022 , metrics: https://metrics.redwood.ai/d/redwood/mirror-4022
ops-oncall: adding quick dashboards to watch: mirror_error_rate, prod_error_rate_delta, p95_delta, auth_failures_by_tenant.
jess: added release-note blurb and flagged SDK team to update streaming docs.
linh: green so far at +2h. proceeding to ramp plan: mirror -> 25% between 04:30-04:40 UTC, monitor 30m, then decision.
deploy-bot: ramping mirror now to 25% (cmd: `./deploy --mirror=0.25 --mirror-id=mirror-4022`)
sara: at 25% still stable. p95 +18ms, errors +0.02% (within tolerance).
matt: confirmed internal QA runs on tenant-42 passed. no semantic diffs in outputs for our eval set.
ops-oncall: keep watch. recall: auto-stop if thresholds breached.
linh: if everything holds for another hour, we'll open a follow-up thread for full switch planning (and schedule a shorter change window). thank you all :) :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: mirror ended at 05:05 UTC (manual stop by linh). mirror summary: duration=2h55m, avg_mirror_error=0.015%, max_p95_delta=22ms, no auto-rollbacks triggered.
jess: leaving notes for downstream SDK owners and ops runbook updated.
matt: postmortem? low-risk but let's capture tenant pin edge cases. will draft a short one.
linh: perfect. I'll follow up with a short doc and next steps for streaming endpoints.
